details:
Run an even race. Halfway in ~1:34:30–1:35:00.
Miles 1–3: 7:15–7:20 (should feel too easy)
Miles 4–13.1: 7:10–7:13
Miles 14–20: 7:10–7:13 — stay patient, fuel on schedule
Miles 20–26.2: 7:05–7:12 only if strong
Aim for 7:10–7:12 on the watch (GPS reads long).

title: Race-morning fueling
details:
3 h before: 2–3 g carbs/kg (150–225 g) — bagel, banana, jam, sports drink.
Gel 10–15 min before the start, then one every 25–30 min (6–7 gels) + sports drink at aid stations for 60–90 g/hour.
Caffeine (optional): ~3 mg/kg (~200 mg) 1 h before, or a caffeinated gel after mile 16.
